purpose: Teach: あゆみ/つきあっ/すさまじい/このほど/とかく/ぬけ/かれこれ/めちゃめちゃ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前との部活のあゆみ、長いよな
lines.en: Riku, we've been doing club together for a really long time, haven't we.
lines.style: Warm, slightly wistful opening. Soft acknowledgment of time passing. Even pace, looking sideways at him rather than straight on. The tone of someone realizing something as they say it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ずっとつきあってくれてサンキューな、桜
lines.en: You've stuck with me this whole time. Thanks, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet and genuine. No performance. Says the name with care — settling into the moment. Breath underneath the words, like he's saying something he doesn't usually say.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、すさまじい量の宿題抱えてんな
lines.en: You're carrying around an insane amount of homework, though.
lines.style: Observant, light tease. Noticing what he doesn't want noticed. Quick delivery, eyebrow up slightly. Affection hiding in the wry tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、このほど志望校決まったろ?桜
lines.en: Wait — didn't you just decide on your university recently?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity beneath the casual question. Turning the focus on her. Slight lift at the end, like he's asking something he cares about the answer to.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、とかく勉強サボるよな
lines.en: You keep skipping studying, no matter what.
lines.style: Light accusation wrapped in familiarity. Not criticizing — just stating what he knows about her. Half-smirk in the delivery. The tone of someone who's watched this happen a hundred times.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、答案用紙、名前ぬけてたぞ、桜
lines.en: You left your name off the test answer sheet, remember?
lines.style: Dry, pointed callback. Not mean-spirited — reminding her of her own contradictions. Matter-of-fact pace. A small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前とかれこれ五年の付き合いだな
lines.en: It's been five years now, us doing this together.
lines.style: Quiet realization. Not quite a question but open at the end. Slower pace than before. Voice settling into the weight of time. Looking at him when she says it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストでめちゃめちゃ点数取ったな、桜
lines.en: You absolutely crushed that last test, by the way.
lines.style: Genuine praise, no irony. Warm, direct. Brief and solid — she doesn't soften or overplay it. The voice of someone who sees his effort and isn't shy about saying so.
